ahmad.name: Ahmad
ahmad.about: Ahmad is a DevOps engineer in Amman, Jordan, working remotely for a German company. He is learning German for daily life and a possible move to Germany. Speaking and understanding matter; exams do not.

maryan.name: Maryan
interests: a part-time job on the side
planning a semester or an internship in Germany
maryan.about: Maryan is a mechanical engineering student in Amman, Jordan, at a basic level. She is learning German on her own, on her phone in the evenings, for her studies, for everyday life, and because she is planning an exchange semester or an internship at a German engineering company. Her world is lectures, labs, CAD projects and student life, not office work. When she talks about herself, feminine forms are the correct ones (Studentin, Ingenieurin, Kollegin, die Neue); an adjective after sein does not change (Ich bin müde).
